name: multi-tenant-wiring
description: Canonical wiring for a tenant-scoped @velajs/crud resource: multiTenant() upstream + tenantResolverMounted: true on the bridge config.

scripts.sync:deps: pnpm run build:vela && pnpm run build:crud && pnpm install
scripts.build: pnpm run sync:deps && rm -rf dist && swc src -d dist --strip-leading-paths && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
